notes.title: Patreon Launch for Invasion 2037 & Creatures Inc
notes.notes:
Hello amazing community!

We're thrilled to announce a significant step forward in the development of our games, Invasion 2037 & Creatures Inc . Your unwavering support and enthusiasm have been our driving force, and we're ready to take things to the next level.

🎮 Why Patreon?
Game development is a passion for us, but it comes with its challenges. To ensure that we can continue creating incredible experiences for you, we're launching a Patreon page. This platform allows you, our dedicated community, to directly contribute to the development process and be a crucial part of bringing these games to life.

🌟 What Can You Expect?
By becoming a Patreon supporter, you'll gain exclusive access to behind-the-scenes content, sneak peeks, access to early build, and even the opportunity to directly influence certain aspects of the game's development. We've crafted unique and exciting rewards to express our gratitude for your support.

💡 How to Support:
Visit our Patreon page https://www.patreon.com/chiefbeaver to explore the different tiers and choose the one that best suits you. Every contribution, no matter the size, makes a significant impact and helps us continue doing what we love - creating extraordinary gaming experiences.

🙌 Join Us on this Journey!
Your support means the world to us, and we're genuinely excited to embark on this journey with you. Let's make Invasion 2037 & Creatures Inc the best they can be, together!

Thank you for being an integral part of our community.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - SEPT01 and Price Drop
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

I've decided to update you on my progress for the 1.2 update at least once a month.
I also decided to drop the price of the game to 9.99 USD, as long as the game has not been updated.

I integrated a new controller, including a new combat system / crafting / looting / building. This new system is replicated, meaning it will be possible to play 2 players online coop. The ability to play co-op will not be available in Update 1.2, but should be available in Update 1.3.

Here is what I need to finish for the launch of the 1.2 update:

- integrate the 80 items to craft and loot. - 30% done -

- Integrate the new bunker and the ability to craft/build the elements of the bunker. - 60% done -

- Redo the mission system and review the game progression and story. - 0% done-

- integrate the new enemy spawn system, a fluid system and optimize - 80% done -

Here is a screenshot of the new bunker. Don't hesitate if you have any questions :

https://ibb.co/y5Hjggm

I can't wait to show you more.

Chief Beavers

notes.title: Follow up and new information on update 2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

I'm working hard and things are progressing well for the next update 2.0, which will bring a whole new start to the game.

Here is the new structure of the game, 4 main steps to complete the game:

- Protect the base and build the necessary protection and survival elements.

- Repaired and improved a bus to have a mobile base and explore the map.

- Build a laboratory and make a vaccine to cure infected people.

- Recruit people and build a guerrilla to fight the aliens.

Also, a brand new economy system has been developed, a new loot system with over 150 different items, a new crafting system with over 60 craftable items and the addition of vendors to buy or sell your loot.

A brand new system for the management of enemies in real time, currently there are 3000 live zombies on the map in a totally random way, and this without any loss of performance.

Thank you for your support and patience.

Also you will be able to repair a school bus and use it as a mobile base and equip it to strengthen it and add weapons to it. 

I will tell you more news about those new gameplay next month. However, this new update will not be available before the end of the year, I will keep you updated every month on the progress of the work.

notes.title: Partnership with an Equinox Games team
notes.notes:
As you already know, I have been developing Invasion 2037 on my own for the past year and part-time for several months. I have a good news to announce, I am partnering with an Equinox Games team to develop the new version of Invasion 2037. Equinox Games is made up of 3 developers and they will help me with the development on the programming side, the game design and the 3d modeling. We will be working and launching regular updates every 3 to 4 months. 

We will be transparent about the work of our updates and in the coming weeks you will be able to follow our progress month after month. We will give you access to our development work schedule. We are currently working on the game design for the new version, based on your experiences with the game and your comments. I can't wait to launch this new version. 

Thank you for your support and your patience.

notes.title: Information about the game
notes.notes:
The Team B  want to thank you for all your good comments :) 

Also they want to inform you on topics that they have seen in some gameplay video.

1) The game world is divided into 3 sections, the central part where you start the game is the first section, the destroyed city to the south once past the bridge is the section 2 and the 3rd section at north will be added later. So the map that you find at the beginning include only the first section. The section 1 and 2 are actually available.

2) The game seems difficult but it has been done so that you need to progress step by step, you need to explore around and come back save your game and make your improvements. And you can progress a little further each time.

3) To put gas in the generator, it is necessary to improve the bunker and unlock the interior garden that will help you to create biodiesel for your generator.

4) The main purpose of the game is to create a vaccine and this is done in the menu of improvements, all the game revolves around the menu of improvements, this way that the game progresses.
